Definitions, units, validation and explanations come from [settings_definitions.py](../app/settings_definitions.py). Released values remain in [the catalog](../pipelines.md); explicit overrides are applied by [the resolver](../app/pipelines/resolver.py). Current defaults do not replace released values.

## Embedded runtime limits

These limits were not fields in the released catalog. They retain their existing effective values and have no new user override surface. They are recorded separately in experiment manifests and answer-cache identity; they are not silently presented as catalog-pinned settings.

| Setting | Default | Effective value | Runtime units | Meaning | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nudge_limit` | `2` | `2` | nudges | Shared allowance for minimum-investigation and no-tool nudges. | [app/agent/runner.py](../app/agent/runner.py) |
| `compaction_recent_tools` | `6` | `6` | messages | Latest tool messages kept intact; compaction does not impose a final input bound. | [app/context/conversation.py](../app/context/conversation.py) |
| `compaction_chars` | `22000` | `22000` | characters | Content-size trigger; excludes tool schemas and structured tool arguments. Display-only estimate: approximately 5,500 tokens at four characters/token. | [app/context/conversation.py](../app/context/conversation.py) |
| `compaction_ids` | `8` | `8` | IDs | Maximum matching passage IDs retained per older compacted tool result. | [app/context/conversation.py](../app/context/conversation.py) |
| `tool_result_chars` | `9000` | `9000` | characters | Displayed JSON payload prefix before the existing ellipsis; not a tokenizer limit. Display-only estimate: approximately 2,250 tokens at four characters/token. | [app/agent/protocol.py](../app/agent/protocol.py) |
| `http_connect_seconds` | `10` | `10` | seconds | Connection timeout for answering-agent HTTP calls. | [app/models/agent.py](../app/models/agent.py) |
| `ollama_read_seconds` | `900` | `900` | seconds | Ollama answering-agent HTTP read timeout. | [app/models/agent.py](../app/models/agent.py) |
| `openai_chat_read_seconds` | `180` | `180` | seconds | OpenAI Chat Completions HTTP read timeout. | [app/models/agent.py](../app/models/agent.py) |
| `openai_responses_read_seconds` | `300` | `300` | seconds | OpenAI Responses HTTP read timeout. | [app/models/agent.py](../app/models/agent.py) |

## Reproduction and identity

Regenerate with `python -m app.settings_reference`; verify with `python -m app.settings_reference --check`. For an effective provider/override example, use `--settings-json` and `--output` to write a separate reference without replacing this default example.

Compaction and clipping still count characters. Token estimates are explanatory only; they do not truncate requests, change evidence selection, or guarantee a context bound. The protected conversation handoff is unchanged.

All resolved agent values remain in run manifests and cache identity. The effective embedded runtime limits now also appear under `runtime_settings` in the pipeline manifest and exact-answer cache identity. Legacy answer entries without this dimension are conservatively excluded from reuse. Released pipeline IDs/checksums are unchanged; source manifests distinguish this code revision. Retrieval configuration and model identities continue to be recorded by the existing pipeline config manifest.
